evidence: The production of excretory-secretory molecules from Heligmosomoides polygyrus bakeri fourth stage larvae varies between mixed and single sex cultures
Two independent experiments were conducted on ES obtained from nematode culture collected from independently infected mice.
The production of excretory-secretory molecules from Heligmosomoides polygyrus bakeri fourth stage larvae varies between mixed and single sex cultures
Two independent analyses of the ES samples were conducted.
This included 258 proteins derived from mixed L4 ES, 160 from female ES and 172 from male ES.
